name: Rocco James Petrillo

residences.place: 337 North Bromley Ave, Scranton, Lackawanna County, PA
residences.note: Contact Mary Petrello at same address; employed by A.C.&F. (American Car & Foundry), Berwick, Columbia Co.

bioAdditions: Rocco James Petrello's 1942 'old man's' draft registration gives his birth as 8 Sept 1889 in Italy. That matches Geni's 8 Sep 1889 rather than the FamilySearch tree's 19 Sep (S1). He was then living at 337 North Bromley Avenue in Scranton's West Side with his wife Mary (Giordano), and worked for American Car & Foundry at Berwick. So this other Guardiese Petriello family also passed through Scranton, but there is still no evidence linking him to John Petriello's household. He is the son of Michelarcangelo Petriello and Benedetta Ladye (FS) and should not be merged with John's children.

conflicts.assessment: Prefer 8 Sep 1889 (self-reported primary record, agrees with Geni).
